context_requirements: No specific transcriptional context is expected; succinimide antiepileptics act primarily on neuronal ion channels and have no known direct transcriptional targets in the assayed cell lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is not explained by generic stress or cytotoxicity.
Evidence of a direct transcriptional target or pathway engagement (e.g., consistent induction of a specific gene set) at 10 micromolar.
